description: Deterministic supplementary checks for the fixed-sample zero-free disk, logarithmic-rate analytic parameters, and global-sector obstruction. The manuscript proofs establish the stated results. These checks are not formal or interval-certified verification and do not prove the optimal fixed-sample Berry--Esseen conjecture.

metadata.model_selection: Explicit rational laws and specified real weights; no random generator.
metadata.fixed_sample_arithmetic: Exact fractions for union-state probabilities; real weighted transforms at 90 digits.
metadata.graph_arithmetic: Independent-subset enumeration followed by subset summation; all small induced subgraphs checked.
metadata.hoeffding_arithmetic: Explicit probability-weighted kernel matrices, canonicality sums, and mpmath SVD; nonnegative weights only.
metadata.two_community_arithmetic: Exact integer sequence counts from two independent methods, then 90-digit rescaling.
metadata.zero_free_scope: Finite evaluations are non-certificates; continuum zero-freeness requires the proof.
